newsitem.title: USA: Ventures Resource sets Eritrea writeoff.
newsitem.headline: Ventures Resource sets Eritrea writeoff.

text.p: Ventures Resource Co said Tuesday it has elected to withdraw from its interests in Eritrea, adding this will result in a writedown of about US$1 million dollars in the second quarter, ending September 30. In statement, the company said directors voted to focus exploration efforts in Alaska in light of the successes achieved in a short period there and a further appreciation of the company's Alaskan assets.
Ventures also said its $5.5 million 1997 Alaskan exploration program is being financed with cash on hand.

Announcing the results of drilling on the Golden Horn and Black Creek mid-stage projects located on the Flat property in Southwestern Alaska, Ventures said significant intersections of gold mineralization were obtained in eight of the 10 holes drilled and all holes intersected anomalous gold mineralization.
This drilling represents about 40 percent of the planned drilling on the Flat property scheduled for completion this summer, the company said.

"This is further confirmation that we are dealing with a big gold system as evidenced by the more than 1.5 million ounces of historic gold production on the Flat property," said Riz Bigelow, president of WGM Inc and a Ventures director.
WGM, the Alaskan subsidiary of Watts, Griffis and McDuat Ltd, plans and executes Ventures' exploraition program, the company said.
